'I had near-death experience and was almost dragged to hell by terrifying gnarled fingers'

LuAnn VanBuskirk says she was faced with the ultimate choice—heaven or hell—and believes she came terrifyingly close to the latter after dismissing God in her youth

13:50, 14 Sep 2026

Since the dawn of humanity, people have wrestled with one profound question: what happens when we die? Now, one woman claims she has the answer. LuAnn VanBuskirk says she was faced with the ultimate choice - heaven or hell - and believes she came terrifyingly close to the latter after dismissing God in her youth.

‌

Her chilling encounter, she says, came when she was just 18 years old. Cycling in Michigan, US, LuAnn made a split-second mistake at a junction and was struck by a truck, sending her flying from her bike and leaving her on the brink of death.

‌

In typical near-death experience (NDE) fashion, LuAnn says she watched her body from above. But then the scene turned into something straight out of Dante’s Inferno: a terrifying hand with "gnarly" fingers reached up from the abyss and yanked her down.

‌

LuAnn says she was nearly dragged into the bowels of hell and remembers a city shrouded in yellow fog - until, she claims, the Lord intervened on her behalf with a stark warning.

LuAnn describes hearing a thunderous boom in the abyss before what she believes was the voice of God. She says the voice conveyed anger at how she had behaved in her life up to that point.

‌

She adds that she had previously mocked God, and thinks she was being shown the consequences of refusing to embrace Him. According to her, God stated it simply: "My word says."

LuAnn also came to understand that she was "going to hell based on my own free will choices". LuAnn admits she’d previously consumed alcohol and used cannabis, then says she told the Lord she knew Jesus Christ.

However, "when it spoke, it did the same thing", creating a "thunderous" noise that "shook" her like "a dead man twice". LuAnn said: "This sound said, 'Even the very demons believe in Jesus. How do you say you do better?'"

‌

She said that every sin from her past was brought up - one after another - until she says she was given a choice to accept God. LuAnn describes feeling “spiritual” pain, and says it sparked a change in her.

Before her near-death experience, LuAnn says she doubted God and couldn’t understand why He would let her suffer.

Now, she claims the experience left her with unshakable faith.

LuAnn says the bizarre experience didn’t even end there. According to her, she also was given signs and came face-to-face with well-known figures from Christian tradition, including John the Baptist and a nun she believes was Mary, Christ’s mother.

The woman added that she later encountered her paternal relatives, including her uncle and his spouse, who assisted her.
